milestones.event: Ruskababa introduced Goa trance through underground summertime parties in Finland.
Smooth Underground and then Löyhä developed the Finnish party scene; Löyhä emphasized locally made music.
Early Tim Thick recordings circulated in Goa.
Flippin Bixies was self-published and became an early defining compilation.
Exogenic Records began focusing on Finnish psychedelic trance and Midiliitto formed around the same period.
Thixx'n'Dixx launched as an online catalogue/distribution point for Suomisaundi.
